ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with sparse, high-intensity (white) localized pixels. Macro-level ratio favors low-intensity by approximately 15:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigment base. Localized white point-source clusters are mapped across the medial section of the right lobe. Linear high-contrast white structures mapped to the lower-left quadrant of the visible surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at central axis; angle estimated at approximately 40 degrees with significant depth before joining lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile. Pixel-amplitude of peaks is higher at the distal ends of the lobes compared to the medial sections near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Right lobe exhibits a convex upward curve towards the distal tip. Left lobe exhibits a downward convex sweep partially obscured by water turbulence.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several roughly circular high-contrast white clusters distributed in the central and right-medial regions of the fluke surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of intersecting white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe, primarily oriented diagonally from bottom-left to top-right.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent intersecting white linear rake marks on the left lobe surface; localized white scarring on the right lobe mid-section.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged, irregular trailing edge boundary particularly at the distal tips, creating a saw-tooth profile.
